第19章 解释巨款来源-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

他先是转头对着王大雷说道：“王哥，你先去把店门关上吧。”

王大雷听话的点了点头，快步走到门口，关上店门，又从里面反锁好，然后重新走回茶台旁边坐下，他对这事也好奇的紧。

吴姜对王大雷很信任，吴时安和王雅琴也一样。说起来，王大雷还是吴姜的救命恩人。

那是吴姜大一的时候，放假回家，在古玩城里面溜达，突然有一个精神失常的人，不知道从哪儿摸出一把刀，见人就砍，场面十分混乱。

吴姜当时吓得腿都软了，跑慢了一步，眼看那把刀就要砍到他身上，正巧过来喊他去吃饭的王大雷，想都没想就冲了过来，一把将他推开，自己却硬生生挨了一刀。

王大雷为此在医院里住了整整三个月，才慢慢康复。

也正因为这件事，吴家一家人都对王大雷感激不尽，早已把他当成了自家人。

吴姜看到门关好了，才想好怎么开口，还是用爷爷糊弄王老板家的那一套就行。

“是这样的，我上大学的时候，有一次在学校门口，看到一个穿着道袍、浑身邋遢的老道士，看他可怜，我就请他吃了顿饭。”

“没想到，那老道士吃完饭后，非得说我骨骼惊奇，是块学道的好料子，死活要收我做徒弟。我一开始也以为他是骗子，可他给我露了几手后，我就信了，平时没事就跟着他学了点东西。”

“他教我的都是一些神神道道的东西，我一开始也没当回事，就是觉得好玩，跟着学学而已。直到这次回去，碰到王积友的儿子被鬼缠上了，找了好多人都没用，爷爷就领我去了王家。”

“我试着用师傅教我的本事，把那只缠人的鬼给收拾了，王积友感激不尽，就给了我这一百万作为报酬。”

吴姜说完，一脸真诚地看着三人。

王雅琴皱着眉，一脸“你在逗我”的表情，你小子搁这儿写小说呢？

倒是吴时安和王大雷，脸上居然露出了半信半疑的表情。

王雅琴有些无语，看向两人：“不是，时安、大雷，你们俩真信这小子说的？”

吴时安先是点了点头，又摇了摇头，缓缓说道：“有鬼这事，我倒是相信是真的。至于他是不是帮王家捉鬼了，我就不知道了。我们干古玩这行，稀奇古怪的事情多了去，有时候怕你害怕，就没跟你说过。”

王大雷也在一旁附和着点头：“是啊，婶子，吴叔主要是不收鬼货，您才见得少。古玩城这边，有好几家店铺专门收鬼货，不定时的就会闹出点动静来。”

He first turned to Wang Dalei and said, "Brother Wang, go and close the store door first."

Wang Dalei nodded obediently, walked quickly to the door, closed the store door, and locked it from the inside. Then he walked back to the tea table and sat down. He was also very curious about this matter.

Wu Jiang has great trust in Wang Dalei, as do Wu Shi'an and Wang Yaqin.Speaking of which, Wang Dalei was Wu Jiang's savior.

It was when Wu Jiang was in his freshman year. He went home during the holidays and was walking around the antique city. Suddenly, a mentally disturbed man took out a knife from nowhere and started slashing at everyone he saw. The scene was very chaotic.

Wu Jiang was so frightened that his legs were weak and he ran a step slower. Seeing that the knife was about to hit him, Wang Dalei happened to come over to call him to eat. He rushed over without thinking and pushed him away, but he was stabbed.

Wang Dalei stayed in the hospital for three full months before slowly recovering.

It is precisely because of this incident that the Wu family is extremely grateful to Wang Dalei and has long regarded him as one of their own.

When Wu Jiang saw that the door was closed, he thought about how to speak. He would just use the trick that his grandfather used to fool Boss Wang's family.

"It's like this. When I was in college, I once saw a slovenly old Taoist priest wearing Taoist robes at the school gate. I saw how pitiful he was, so I treated him to a meal."

"Unexpectedly, after the meal, the old Taoist priest insisted on saying that I had amazing bones and was a good material for learning Taoism, and he wanted to accept me as his disciple. I thought he was a liar at first, but after he showed me a few tricks, I believed him, and I just learned something from him."

"He taught me some mysterious things. I didn't take it seriously at first. I just thought it was fun and just followed him to learn. Until I went back this time and met Wang Jiyou's son being haunted by ghosts. I called many people to no avail, so grandpa took me to Wang's house."

"I tried to use the skills my master taught me to deal with the pestering ghost. Wang Jiyou was so grateful that he gave me this million as a reward."

After Wu Jiang finished speaking, he looked at the three of them sincerely.

Wang Yaqin frowned, with an "Are you kidding me" expression on her face, are you writing a novel here?

Wu Shi'an and Wang Dalei, on the other hand, had doubtful expressions on their faces.

Wang Yaqin was speechless and looked at the two of them: "No, Shi An, Dalei, do you really believe what this guy said?"

Wu Shi'an nodded first, then shook his head, and said slowly: "I believe it is true that there is a ghost. As for whether he helped the Wang family catch ghosts, I don't know. We are in the antique business, and there are many weird things. Sometimes I am afraid that you will be scared, so I never told you."

Wang Dalei also nodded in agreement: "Yes, Auntie, Uncle Wu mainly doesn't accept ghost goods, so you don't see much of it. Here in the Antique City, there are several shops that specialize in collecting ghost goods, and there will be some noise from time to time."
